page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right and gathering signature at the lower left.

main_text.p: De anni temporibus, horumq; temperie, intemperieq; supra in quæstione, an autumnus rectè dicatur frigidus & siccus, abunde dictum est, quare lectorem eò remitto.
Mundi Regiones sequuntur, Asia, Africa, Europa, America.

Europæi ob calidi innati & influentis ubertatem sunt audaces, robusti, longiorisq; vitæ, inter quos Germani, ut placuit Gale.2.de temp, & Seneca sunt iracundi, fortes, audaces, graves, armorumque cupidi.

Per Europæos intelligè Britannos, Germanos, Gallos, Hispanos, Italos. Sarmatas (h e. Polonos, Borussos, Effluos, Stefflender/Letuanos Littawer/Russos, Neuffen/Pomeranos Pommern/) Danos, Suecos, Dacos, Walachen/ Transsyluanos, Siebenbürger / Pannones, Vngern/ Tartaros, Tartern/ Mœsos, Die in[?] Bulgarey/Pannonib.vicinos, Thraces, Macedones, Græcos, Dalmatas, Istros Hisferreich-cher/Italiæ attingentes ad mare Adriaticū, &c.

Verum ut aerem & cœlum non habent hi unum & idem, sic etiam vita & moribus sunt diversissimis. Galli suffragiis Iustini, Cæsaris, Herodiani & Galeni sunt belliçosi & audaces, sed sitis impatientes. Pannonii teste Piur[?], sunt hebeti & tardo ingenio, sed ad bellum paratis-simi. Itali, teste Vitruvio, providi & sapientes sunt, compositi scilicet factiq; ex Mercurio &

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Piur" (after "teste", probably an abbreviated author name); "Die in" in black letter after "Mœsos," (unclear); signature "B 5" at the lower left (the 5 is doubtful); "Hisferreich-cher" is printed with a hyphen at the line end and is black letter; "(h e." is probably "h. e." (hoc est), printed without the second stop. Black letter words were marked with bl; their exact letterforms are not fully certain. The running head is taken as printed: "PROROGANDA A."
